$schema_note: Minimum-privilege IAM policy for the ReciterAI daily-enrichment Fargate task role (#37 PR 4). Attach to the task role referenced by `ecs_task_definition.json.taskRoleArn`. No `bedrock:InvokeModel` — the task authenticates to Bedrock via the `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` bearer token (plan D8 / PR-4 D-Q1), so SigV4 IAM auth against the task role is intentionally not load-bearing. Dropping the IAM grant gives the task the loud-failure mode on a missing/stale bearer token: SigV4 fallback against the role → 403 → CloudWatch error → Teams alert on the next tick. Adding `bedrock:InvokeModel` back is a one-line policy edit if the auth substrate ever changes.
